_doc: Season windows — the single authoritative definition of when PJL's seasonal
services run. Lives here at the repo root alongside pricing.json / parts.json,
and is read by server/lib/seasons.js. Edit the JSON, not the code.
Before this file existed, the fall window was hardcoded in server/lib/outreach.js
as Sep 1 - Dec 15. The real fall 2026 season ends Nov 6 (hard frost); the last 39
days of that window were not serviceable, which made 'is this customer already
booked for fall?' unreliable and put December dates in front of the operator.
SHAPE
defaults[season]  - year-agnostic fallback, MM-DD. Applies to any year with no
entry under `years`. Fall defaults to the Nov 6 frost stop,
NOT the Dec 15 the old hardcoded constant used: a year nobody
has planned should inherit a safe date rather than a known-
wrong one. A comment warning that 2027 would reinherit the bug
is not a control; this is. Spring's defaults are its long-
standing Mar 1 - Jun 30 and are unchanged.
A year that runs later than the default is a year someone must
plan explicitly under `years` — erring toward too short means
a late booking reads as unbooked and the customer gets one
more nudge; erring long means offering work past frost.
years[YYYY][season] - full YYYY-MM-DD dates, overriding the default for that
year. Add a new year by adding a block here; no code change.
FIELDS (per season)
serviceableFrom      First day a truck rolls. Inclusive.
serviceableThrough   Last day a truck rolls. Inclusive. Hard frost stop in fall.
publicBookingFrom    OPTIONAL. First day the public flow accepts a self-serve
booking. Defaults to serviceableFrom when absent. Fall 2026
sets Sep 28 — the first planned route day — so a customer
cannot self-book a September date no truck is scheduled to
serve. Consumed by the same availability.js season gate.
publicBookingThrough Last day the public flow accepts a self-serve booking.
Intentionally earlier than serviceableThrough in fall 2026
(Oct 30 vs Nov 6), reserving Nov 1-6 for admin placement so
there is routing room at season end.
Consumed by the season gate in server/lib/availability.js:
days after this date emit no public slots for seasonal
services (the admin picker is not gated). Where no admin-
reserved tail is defined, it equals serviceableThrough.
TIMEZONE
These are plain calendar dates in America/Toronto, PJL's operating timezone.
Consumers compare them against local date fields; server.js pins process.env.TZ
= America/Toronto at boot so that math is honest. See server/lib/seasons.js.
PLANNING EACH YEAR
A year with no block here inherits `defaults`. That is a safe floor, not a
forecast — add each season's real dates under `years` as it is planned, and set
publicBookingThrough to reserve whatever admin-placement tail that season needs.
